reel.caption:
Is your Diwali bonus taxed while a voucher isn't?

From 1 April 2026, gifts, vouchers and tokens from your employer are tax-free up to ₹15,000 a year (the old limit was ₹5,000). It applies in both tax regimes.
A cash bonus isn't a gift: it's salary, taxed at your slab rate.
Illustrative: at the 30% slab plus 4% cess, ₹15,000 in cash loses about ₹4,680 to tax.
